text:
I wrote the report with verdict `fix`. The main reason is that the review shots show the wrong pages, so I couldn't check the slim header visually.

- **Wrong pages shot:** the shots are of `/sessions/v/` (the variants index) and `/sessions/v/classic/` (the old controls). Neither draws the slim header, so the sticky row, the menus and the phone first screen are unverified.
- **Readme not updated:** the diff has no change to `sessions/readme.md`, which the brief required.
- **Sticky offset never set:** the header's `top` reads `var(--sessions-header-top, 0)`, and nothing in the diff sets that variable, so it may sit behind the site's tabs.

The rest of the report is notes, plus the per-system sections answered from the diff alone. I made no code edits.

The report is at `public/framework/ai/sessions/2026/10/20/session-e00f55c9/sessions-and-tasks/sessions-list-slim/header/review/report.md`.
